sec: CKD mimics & the AKI arm · p749

items.q: Fill up: In the hours-to-days AKI list, ATN is expanded on this page as acute tubular ______.
items.exp: The printed lines are 'Acute tubular nephrosis (ATN)' and 'Acute interstitial nephrosis (AIN)' — the page uses nephrosis for both, unlike the usual nephritis wording seen elsewhere in the notes. (Book p749)

items.q: The postrenal line of the AKI branch reads B/L hydroureteronephrosis with USG written in brackets.
opts: True — ultrasound is the study named against postrenal AKI
False — the bracketed investigation is CT abdomen
False — the line names retrograde pyelography
True — and the same line adds 'diagnosed with biopsy'
items.exp: Printed: 'Postrenal : B/L hydroureteronephrosis (USG)'; the biopsy line belongs to RPGN in the days-to-weeks branch. (Book p749)
